title: Response header built from input (java) — review required
description: A java response call sets a header from assembled parts: res.setHeader("X-N", "v" + n). CRLF sequences in untrusted input split the response and inject headers or body bytes. This lexical rule flags the assembly; the reviewer confirms the value is validated.
remediation: Validate the value against a token-charset allowlist (no CR/LF, expected charset) before setting the header.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any assembled header matches; modern frameworks often reject CRLF, which the reviewer should confirm.
